The dev stopped on the breach and explained it (PR #24200, report 6237251180, deviation 1 and open question 2). The seat takes **option A: the surface is amended, and the page retirement stays.** Ruling B (`6216295104`) binds the retirement ("the separate Installed Apps view retires once the filtered view serves its actions"), and the dev measured that it does: at the pin, the old page only redirected.

**File surface, added:**
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.ts`, only the `pages.marketplace_installed` entry, and `{zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.source-hashes.ts`, only its two hash lines. Without them the `pages.*` parity check reports the retired page as an orphan. This is `domain:engine`'s package, declared on #6367 in this act.
- `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`, which read `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE.pages`.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` (its page population drops the retired page) and a one-line comment in `packages/cloud-connection/vitest.config.ts`.

**`Clause-②` (open question 1):** the published type of `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` changes, and `GET /api/v1/meta/page` stops listing `marketplace_installed`. Those are narrowings of a served set and of an exported constant's type, so the line stays a `no`. This PR owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record (narrowing face) before the queue. That review is commissioned in this act. It judges whether the changeset and PR body carry the `(narrowing)` arm and the semver level, and a patch round carries whatever it requires.
